biscuit.name: Biscuit
biscuit.about: Odessa's moon-tortoise, older than the Moth and twice as stubborn. Rides on the dashboard in a knitted cosy.

hob.name: Hob
hob.about: Ilse's starling. Has flown every race with her for nine years and screams at anyone who overtakes.

lord_pemberton.name: Lord Pemberton
lord_pemberton.about: The Dowager Crake's lapdog, a fluffy cloud with opinions. Thaddeus pretends not to adore him.

flutter.name: Flutter
flutter.about: Pip's silver space-moth, who hatched in the Dandelion's air filter and decided Pip was her mother.

chili.name: Chili
chili.about: The Okafors' lizard, who lives in the Brothy's warm kitchen and eats only ginger, and only when no one is looking.

gerald.name: Gerald
gerald.about: Dr. Yaneva's fern, which eats flies very politely and once ate a glove. Dr. Yaneva maintains it was an accident.

up: Odessa was seen pressing a seed cake on Thaddeus Crake at the market. He took it. He said thank you, quietly, to the cake.
Crake held the door of the tea shop for Odessa. Odessa says it's the start of something. Crake says it was a draught.
down: Odessa told Crake his yacht 'looks like a fancy eggplant'. Crake has not recovered.
Crake complained the Pocket Moth was parked in his bay. It was not his bay. Words were had.

up: Brindle timed Ilse's warm-up laps and read the results back to her in a dramatic voice. She pretended to hate it.
Ilse let Brindle ride in the Heron's spare seat for one lap. Brindle has told everyone. Several times.
down: Brindle announced Ilse's lap times over the dock speakers without asking. Ilse is not speaking to the speakers.
Ilse told Brindle to stop timing her breakfast. Brindle says it was a personal best.

up: Crake was seen cheering at the club race. For Ilse. He claims he was sneezing.
Ilse fixed a loose trim panel on the Magnificence at the dock, free. Crake sent flowers. Expensive ones.
down: Crake asked Ilse when she plans to retire. Loudly. In the cocoa queue.
Ilse's starling Hob screamed at the Magnificence for twenty minutes. Crake has filed a complaint about the bird.

up: Ilse was out on the ring at dawn, showing Pip the lines through the sun-hairpin. Again. Third morning running.
Pip made Ilse a mug that says WORLD'S OKAYEST COACH. She uses it every day.
down: Ilse made Pip run the hairpin forty times. Pip cried on lap thirty. Ilse bought them cocoa after.
Pip skipped a practice to sleep. Ilse sat outside the Dandelion and waited, which was somehow worse.

up: Brindle and Pip are timing each other's lunch. It is not a race. It is somehow a race.
Brindle gave Pip a stopwatch of their very own. Pip has started timing everything too. The dock is concerned.
down: Brindle accidentally announced Pip's spin-out over the speakers. Pip went very red.
Pip asked Brindle not to time their nerves. Brindle said they were 'very fast nerves'. This did not help.

up: Odessa and Dr. Yaneva were spotted in the Odd drum, kneeling in the moon-plum beds, arguing happily about soil.
Dr. Yaneva gave Odessa a cutting from the Glasshouse. Biscuit has eaten one leaf. It's fine. It grew back.
down: Odessa told Dr. Yaneva his lemon tree was 'leggy'. He has not spoken since. The tree is fine.
Biscuit ate one of Dr. Yaneva's seedlings. Odessa says Biscuit has never eaten anything she didn't mean to.

up: Thaddeus Crake has been seen at the Brothy's counter three lunchtimes running. He orders 'the usual'. He has a usual.
Tam named a soup after Crake. It is plum-colored and very rich. Crake pretended to be offended for a full minute.
down: Crake sent back a bowl of noodles for being 'too cheerful'. Tam has taken it personally.
Tam waved a ladle at the Magnificence. Some soup got on it. Diplomatic relations are strained.

up: Juniper and Dr. Yaneva have shaken hands on a deal: his greenhouse greens, in her soups. Tam was not consulted and is thrilled.
Dr. Yaneva taught Juniper to grow ginger in the Brothy's window. Chili has been staring at it for two days.
down: Juniper and Dr. Yaneva disagreed about whether a fern counts as a vegetable. Gerald was present and took it badly.
Dr. Yaneva's delivery of greens was late, and Juniper had to serve plain noodles. She has written him a very polite letter.

up: Sprocket and Chili were found asleep in the same warm spot by the Brothy's oven. Neither will admit it.
Sprocket brought Chili a piece of ginger. Chili accepted it. The dock holds its breath.
down: Sprocket and Chili had a staring contest through the Brothy's window for an hour. Nobody won. Everybody lost.
Chili stole Sprocket's sunbeam. Sprocket has sworn revenge.

up: Sprocket and Biscuit spent the afternoon napping side by side on the Pocket Moth's warm engine cover.
Sprocket has been seen guarding Biscuit's lettuce from Hob. Biscuit did not ask for this, and approves.
down: Biscuit sat in Sprocket's favorite box. Very slowly. There was nothing anyone could do.
Sprocket batted at Biscuit's shell for an hour. Biscuit did not notice. Sprocket is furious about being ignored.
